gate: the candidate may not introduce a decision the baseline never produced, on any case of the frozen turn corpus. A variant that invents one decision is rejected however much it saves. Cases that are nondeterministic inside a single arm are reported rather than hidden, because a set comparison alone would overstate the gate.
method: the real sidecar per variant, whole sessions alternated in ABBA order, the same 12-case corpus twice per session. The candidate removes the two fields from the schema and BAXY fills them back in from mode and effect_operations, so everything downstream sees the identical decision shape.

question: the primary schema makes the model write `operation` and `effect_count`, which the prompt itself declares as functions of `mode` and `effect_operations`. If BAXY derives them instead, does any turn decide differently?

verdict.safety: Both fields are safe by code inspection, not only by corpus evidence. _canonical_turn_decision already recomputed effect_count from len(effect_operations) and discarded the model's value, so the model was being paid to write something always thrown away. validate_turn_decision already required operation == effect_operations[0] and rejected the turn otherwise, so deriving it cannot change an accepted decision; it only removes a rejection that used to cost a whole extra policy call.
verdict.gate: no decision the baseline did not already produce, over 48 samples per arm on the frozen corpus
verdict.production_verification: after promotion, probe_policy_pipeline reports the production primary policy emitting predicted_n p50 = 61.0, exactly the variant's number. The token claim is therefore verified end to end; the millisecond claim rests on the same-session ABBA above, not on any cross-session comparison.
verdict.retracted: an earlier run of this experiment reported -114.7 s... -0.1147 s of turn-level gain. That was noise: turn wall time on this corpus has sd = 1.61 s and the same metric produced -115 ms, -2 ms and -134 ms across three runs of the same experiment. It is retracted and replaced by the P-level measurement.
verdict.not_done_and_why: the prompt still describes the two removed fields. Rewriting it was not promoted because it was not what this experiment measured, and those tokens sit in the cached system prefix where they cost almost nothing: prefill did not move.
